title: Traditional Games
text:
Many children around the world play traditional games. These games are very old. Children play them outside with friends. One popular game is hide and seek.

In hide and seek, one child counts to ten. The other children hide. Then the child looks for them. The game is fun because everyone likes to hide.

questions.text: What is one popular traditional game in the passage?
How many does the child count to in hide and seek?
Why do children like traditional games?
options: They are fun and they play with friends
They need a lot of money

questions.text: What can you infer about hide and seek?
options: It is played by one person alone
It needs more than one player
It is played only in winter

vocabulary.definition: done in the same way for a long time
to go where other people cannot see you
says numbers in order, one after another

paragraph_translations: Dünyanın her yerinde birçok çocuk geleneksel oyunlar oynar. Bu oyunlar çok eskidir. Çocuklar bu oyunları arkadaşlarıyla dışarıda oynar. Popüler bir oyun saklambaçtır.
Saklambaçta bir çocuk ona kadar sayar. Diğer çocuklar saklanır. Sonra çocuk onları aramaya başlar. Oyun eğlencelidir çünkü herkes saklanmayı sever.
